info.title: API.SH: trivago
info.description: The trivago API from API.SH: public trivago data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Hotels for a destination as trivago lists them: name, link, type, stars, rating and review count, coordinates, distance label, image, highlights, themes; with dates, the best deal (booking site, price per night and per stay, all-in prices, room, breakfast/free-cancellation attributes and deadline, booking link), the cheapest deal and other deals per hotel, and the number of sites with prices. Sort by relevance, price, distance or rating; filter by budget per night and any filter from `/trivago/v1/filters` (stars, rating, amenities, property type, chain). Without dates hotels come without prices. `complete=true` waits until every site has answered (slower). Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trivago-search

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Destination id from `/trivago/v1/suggest`, e.g. `59182` (Rio de Janeiro) or `200-59182`; a point of interest as `500-<id>`. Give `destination` or `q`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Destination text instead of an id; the first suggestion is used.

parameters.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: `nights` after check-in.

get.description:
What the trivago search box suggests for a text: destinations (cities, regions, countries), points of interest and hotels with their id (`search_id` goes to `/trivago/v1/search` as `destination`), type and location.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trivago-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text, 2+ characters, e.g. `rio de janeiro`, `copacabana palace`.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: trivago market: sets the default language and currency (default br).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
